tasks.task: Add two regression tests to tests/test_cli.py in the existing TestDecodeToolArguments class proving _decode_tool_arguments returns an empty dict for non-string non-dict inputs such as True and 42. Change nothing else.

Add one guard test to tests/test_cli.py proving every entry in the SLASH_COMMANDS list appears in the output of the '/help' command. Import SLASH_COMMANDS, call the async _handle_command method with '/help', capture printed output with capsys, and assert every entry is present. Write the test class as normal multi-line Python code with real newlines. Change nothing else.

Add one regression test to tests/test_cli.py proving the '/cwd /nonexistent-path-xyz' command keeps the working directory unchanged and prints a message containing 'Directory not found'. Use pytest.mark.asyncio, call the async _handle_command method, and capture stdout with capsys. Change nothing else.
